intro.text: A bridgeman in Bridge Four, one of the first to stand up for Kaladin.
A former bridgeman of Bridge Four who now serves as a guard for the Kholin family under Kaladin.
A member of Bridge Four who can fly using Lashings as a Windrunner squire.
A member of Bridge Four and a Windrunner with a spren of his own.

items.text: Drehy was in Bridge Four when Kaladin began trying to save its men, and was among the first to defend him while others mocked him. In the chasms he slowly began to talk, learned the spear almost as fast as Moash, and was one of the first bridgemen Kaladin taught first aid, along with Rock and Skar.

Drehy said it sickened him to watch Sadeas abandon Dalinar at the Battle of the Tower. Stunned by what Kaladin could do, he swore by the Brightcaller's rays and wondered if Kaladin was a spren rather than a man.

Drehy joined the rest of Bridge Four in guarding the Kholins under Kaladin and helped train men from the other bridge crews, working such long hours that Kaladin asked Teft for more trainers. At dinner one night, he flicked a chunk of longroot at Lopen when the Herdazian claimed to be ready for anything.

As the armies neared the central plateau, Drehy and Skar were assigned to guard Adolin. Drehy insisted on fighting, saying they were no longer facing ordinary Parshendi. The two kept pace with Adolin, cut away ropes the Parshendi had thrown on him, saved him from falling off the plateau and helped him out of his Plate when its Stormlight ran low.

Teft picked Drehy as one of Bridge Four's best to help Adolin and Shallan face the Unmade Re-Shephir in the heart of Urithiru. During the fight he stood in front of Shallan and speared one of its creatures through the head.
Sigzil told Kaladin that Drehy was courting a man named Dru from the market district and asked whether there were forms to fill in for it; Kaladin replied that the Alethi had no such forms.
When Bridge Four went with Rock to look for his family's caravan on the Shattered Plains, they found it had been attacked, and Drehy noted that it was the work of the Voidbringers.
Kaladin chose Drehy and Skar for the small group heading to Kholinar, a sign that Drehy was now counted among Bridge Four's best fighters. On the way, he flew using Lashings as a Windrunner squire.

In Kholinar, Drehy guarded Shallan and Adolin and helped Kaladin push back the enemy at the palace. Kaladin sent him to protect Shallan as she went to confront the Unmade at the Oathgate. He didn't go into Shadesmar with the others, but stayed in Kholinar with Skar to keep fighting.

Following word sent by spanreed, Kaladin found Drehy and Skar in a cave on the Alethi coast. Weak and exhausted, with ash smeared over their tattoos, they had escaped Kholinar with young Gavinor Kholin. Showing Kaladin the boy, Drehy quoted the Second Ideal of the Windrunners.

Back with Kaladin, Drehy bonded a spren of his own. He helped the Windrunners evacuate Hearthstone, fighting the Fused, then went with Skar, Rock and Rock's family to the Horneater Peaks, before returning to the Shattered Plains for Teft's funeral.

appearance.text: A lanky, long-limbed, muscular man with thinning blond hair and a faint accent. Shallan thinks him handsome.

personality.text: Drehy is gay, and has been seeing a man named Dru.
